author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೆಲಸದಲಿ ತೋರುವುದು ಕೆಲಜನರ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ
ಹಲುಬುವರು ಹಲವುಜನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಲವಿರದೆ
ಸುಲಭವಹು ಇತರಲಿಹ ಗುಣದೋಷವೆಣಿಸುದಕೆ
ಗೆಲುನೀನು ನಿರ್ಬಲತೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Some people’s ability shows in their work;
many people complain, having no strength of their own;
it is easy to count up the virtues and faults in others;
conquer your own weakness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Some prove themselves through work; others only complain. Judging others is easy. The real task is overcoming our own weaknesses.
